theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, φ y ∂μ = ∫ y, φ y ∂ν) → μ = ν
